provenance: Static repository structure and explicit import/reference relationships.
authorization: Discovery only; graph edges grant no tool or write authority.

nodes.label: source.contract-ingestion
nodes.summary: Version and required capabilities are configuration, not application constants.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-impact
nodes.summary: Operates on canonical typed nodes and relations without source vocabulary in core policy; direction-aware propagation, complete ordered path receipts and a separate risk policy remain A2.

nodes.label: reasoning.directional-propagation
nodes.summary: Uses source-neutral canonical relations and endpoint roles with explicit direction, depth, evidence-state and path-receipt policies; runtime workflow integration remains pending.

nodes.label: knowledge.evidence-graph
nodes.summary: Treats project-, snapshot-, ontology- and profile-bound normalized evidence as the authority substrate; missing record envelopes remain unverified while durable graph ports and complete path replay remain planned.

nodes.label: knowledge.trusted-edge-envelope
nodes.summary: Compiles and replays source-neutral canonical-edge artifact envelopes against externally pinned project/snapshot, raw and normalized graph, ontology/profile, parser registry/implementation, policy, evidence-state and freshness roots. Release-only gaps are isolated from analysis, all results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY with upstream capture unattested, and no receipt can authorize release.

nodes.label: knowledge.complete-path-replay
nodes.summary: Derives a source-neutral, non-caller-narrowable candidate scope from all graph nodes and every reachable material target under independently pinned path, propagation and R0.1 trust roots; exact current envelope union and ordered path equality are required. Results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible with change-seed and upstream-capture gaps.

nodes.label: knowledge.canonical-ontology
nodes.summary: Deterministically normalizes the current source vocabulary into versioned canonical classes and preserves mapping/trust gaps. Completion requires upstream record envelopes and proof that trusted first-source behavior is preserved; propagation/risk remain separate A2 policy.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-context-compiler
nodes.summary: Compiles an analysis-only, project/snapshot-isolated context pack from replay-validated canonical structure under deterministic atomic count/character/byte budgets. Caller-supplied source fragments and semantic receipts remain non-authoritative candidates; governed resolution, seed-rationale receipts, provider token/time budgets, outcome memory and workflow consumption remain planned.

nodes.label: reasoning.hybrid-candidate-fusion
nodes.summary: Deterministically fuses request-, context-, channel- and freshness-bound exact, lexical, confirmed-graph and semantic candidate receipts under an independently pinned policy/evaluation contract. Outputs remain analysis-only candidates; protected deterministic tiers, conflicts, omissions, outages and upstream context gaps are explicit. Completion requires real channel adapters, trusted A3 verification receipts and an adjudicated hybrid-quality corpus.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-grounded-agent
nodes.summary: Provides a provider-neutral proposal/verifier plus a separately typed replay-validating workflow consumer. The consumer binds the complete change request and graph identity, replays current governance, isolates specialist failures, and can only emit bounded analysis-only candidate/inferred advisory results. Completion requires a real structured-output provider adapter with hard cancellation, independently persisted capture/consumption receipts, retry-safe workflow/checkpoint integration and an adjudicated quality corpus.

nodes.label: reasoning.semantic-retrieval
nodes.summary: Provider-neutral embeddings and standard cosine ranking.

nodes.label: retrieval.chromadb
nodes.summary: Project- and snapshot-isolated persistent semantic index behind the existing retrieval port; PostgreSQL remains authoritative relational memory.

nodes.label: orchestration.multi-agent
nodes.summary: Typed deterministic stages share governed state, and an isolated policy-configured consumer deterministically merges multiple replay-verified specialist artifacts without mutating authoritative run state. Durable live-provider invocation, capture registry, checkpoint/CAS integration and event outbox remain planned.

nodes.label: observability.agent-trace
nodes.summary: Emits bounded typed stage events and deliverables using capability, evidence, artifact, policy and gap identifiers without persisting prompts, secrets or hidden reasoning.

nodes.label: ui.assurance-dashboard
nodes.summary: Projects the typed assurance-run contract without scenario literals or client-side governance rules. It separates source-confirmed, human-recorded, inferred, contradictory and unresolved evidence; selected validations from execution receipts; proposals from applied actions; recorded activity from live dependency availability; and current decisions from audit-only history. Ordered path receipts, A6 advisory payloads, persistence health, runtime response validation and automated accessibility auditing remain planned.

nodes.label: quality.test-selection
nodes.summary: Selects graph-connected test kinds rather than named test cases.

nodes.label: automation.locator-healing
nodes.summary: Uses metadata identity, accessibility semantics and ambiguity abstention.

nodes.label: governance.claim-grounding
nodes.summary: Validates evidence identifiers independently of business domain.

nodes.label: governance.release-decision
nodes.summary: Deterministic policy consumes typed risk and validation state, but a non-bypassable evidence-model interlock currently limits every release posture to INCOMPLETE.

nodes.label: governance.release-input-integrity
nodes.summary: A pinned R0.3 candidate-composition foundation binds the complete v2 run/request candidate surface, candidate change/build bytes, current-replayed R0.2/R0.1 path roots, deterministically replayed risk per stable structural path, advisory downstream payloads and current runtime policy identities into a canonical expiring manifest. It remains ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible because producer-derived change/build, risk factors, obligation/execution, conflict, approval and upstream capture completeness are not yet available; the non-bypassable INCOMPLETE interlock and historical-decision revalidation remain unchanged.

nodes.label: governance.measurement-contract
nodes.summary: Defines executable run-level metric populations, thresholds, applicability and typed guardrail outcomes without treating heuristic scores as calibrated probability.

nodes.label: memory.postgresql
nodes.summary: Target primary non-vector memory. Run documents and checkpoints are wired, and outcome candidates have an append-only replay-validating adapter foundation. Live PostgreSQL outcome transactions/concurrency plus evidence/chunk, graph, audit, approval and evaluation application ports remain.

nodes.label: memory.resilient-fallback
nodes.summary: Run storage falls back from PostgreSQL to auto-created SQLite/process memory; outcome storage independently falls back through auto-created SQLite, immutable JSON and process cache. Health exposes each active mode and never falls through on corruption, replay, schema, idempotency or ambiguous-write failures.

nodes.label: memory.release-outcomes
nodes.summary: Retains replay-validated, append-only and explicitly non-authorizing trusted-test, typed incident and unverified human-correction candidates linked to exact run/project/source and policy roots. Completion requires live PostgreSQL verification, HTTP/MCP exposure, signed/tamper-evident anchoring, historical-policy replay, decision/override/production kinds, prior-outcome retrieval integration and an adjudicated corpus.

nodes.label: tools.mcp
nodes.summary: Tools delegate to shared services and expose no scenario-specific endpoint.

nodes.label: runtime.salesforce-live-evidence
nodes.summary: Planned live reads require validated contract routes, field/route allowlists, production-org refusal and redacted audit events; the current CLI adapter only proves bounded inspection and route validation.

nodes.label: quality.live-test-execution
nodes.summary: Execution consumes selected obligations and configured runners.

nodes.label: automation.browser-worker
nodes.summary: Typed worker accepts a generic intent and ephemeral session handoff.
